compare.title: Living room at spawn
compare.caption: Night, game paused. The real game on the left, the port on the right: geometry, camera, furniture and walls match. Lighting is missing: the light patch by the door and the darkening.

compare.title: Character moved (held-out frame)
compare.caption: A second oracle: the character walked a few tiles, position read from the save. The camera and the wall cutaway rule were checked on this frame without tuning. Most of the remaining difference is lighting.

compare.title: Before: without the visibility mask
compare.caption: The same frame before the visibility mask: the port drew the whole house and yard, while the game shows only the player's room. Difference from the game was 79.7 of 255, now 16.3.

portOnly.title: Cell 41_39, GPU rendering
portOnly.caption: Muldraugh: tiles, floors and draw order read straight from the game's files.
